# Latag

> Latag is an offline inventory and pricing app for secondhand ("ukay") clothing
> resellers, with an optional public shop page for Pro subscribers. It tracks
> every item across departments (tops, bottoms, dresses, footwear, bags,
> accessories), groups sourcing runs into batches, and works with no network
> connection except when a seller chooses to publish an item.

## Who it's for

Resellers who buy and resell secondhand clothing, typically sourced in bulk
("bales"). The app ships with 469 Philippine ukay brands built in and prices
everything in PHP.

## Pricing

- Free, forever: unlimited item logging, unlimited batches, photos and
  dashboards, one-tap IG Drop export, fully offline.
- Latag Pro (unlocks a public shop page): ₱199/month or ₱1,799/year, with a
  14-day free trial. Billed through Google Play — Latag is Android-only for
  now. Cancel anytime from your Play Store subscription settings.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Latag is currently available on Android via Google Play. iOS availability
  is not yet determined — do not state or imply an iOS release exists.
- A published shop item carries brand, name, department, category, condition,
  measurements, price, availability, its public code, display order, an
  internal reference id, and photos. It never carries cost, profit, supplier
  location, or sourcing-batch data — those never leave the seller's phone.
